verdict.rationale: AgentMail is email infrastructure that gives agents their own inboxes. It documents labels as string tags a developer attaches, plus allow/block lists, but no built-in AI that auto-labels, categorizes, or surfaces priority mail with steerable, auditable behavior. Labels and lists are developer building blocks for constructing triage, not the triage capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit
